title: Sparkly diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='g1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bff2ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3ec6e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fdcf5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2099c4'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- crown (top flat facet) -->
  <polygon points='50,18 34,34 66,34' fill='#d8f7ff'/>
  <!-- crown left facet -->
  <polygon points='34,34 50,18 50,34' fill='#a9ecff'/>
  <!-- crown right facet -->
  <polygon points='66,34 50,18 50,34' fill='#7fdcf5'/>
  <!-- crown side-left -->
  <polygon points='28,38 34,34 50,34 50,50' fill='#5fcdec'/>
  <!-- crown side-right -->
  <polygon points='72,38 66,34 50,34 50,50' fill='#3ab2d6'/>
  <!-- table (top face) -->
  <polygon points='34,34 66,34 50,50' fill='#eafcff'/>
  <!-- pavilion left -->
  <polygon points='28,38 50,50 50,82' fill='#49c0e0'/>
  <!-- pavilion right -->
  <polygon points='72,38 50,50 50,82' fill='#2a9ec2'/>
  <!-- girdle band -->
  <polygon points='28,38 34,34 66,34 72,38 50,44' fill='#9be9fb' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- sparkle 1 (top left) -->
  <polygon points='18,14 20,20 26,22 20,24 18,30 16,24 10,22 16,20' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <!-- sparkle 2 (top right) -->
  <polygon points='82,16 84,21 89,23 84,25 82,30 80,25 75,23 80,21' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- sparkle 3 (bottom left) -->
  <polygon points='16,66 17.5,71 22,72.5 17.5,74 16,79 14.5,74 10,72.5 14.5,71' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <!-- sparkle 4 (bottom right, small) -->
  <polygon points='84,68 85.2,72 89,73.2 85.2,74.4 84,78.4 82.8,74.4 79,73.2 82.8,72' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- tiny glints -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='26' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='60' r='1.6' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='1.3' fill='#e8fbff'/>
</svg>
